likelyCauses: The request omitted the API access token or sent it under the wrong header.
nextSteps: Set the X-Access-Key header from a server-side secret and avoid exposing it in client code.
title: Tenderly API access key missing
summary: Tenderly Simulation API calls require an access key header.

likelyCauses: The user opened a full debugger view without an authenticated Tenderly account.
nextSteps: Use the public simulation link for shared context, or sign in before opening the full debugger.
title: Tenderly debugger login required

patterns.value: full debugger requires a Tenderly login

summary: A shared simulation may be visible, but the full Tenderly debugger requires authentication.

likelyCauses: The API endpoint was built with a stale account slug, project slug, or workspace name.
nextSteps: Copy the account/project slugs from the Tenderly dashboard and rebuild the API URL.
title: Tenderly account or project slug invalid
summary: The Tenderly API URL likely contains the wrong account or project slug.

likelyCauses: The transaction call, block tag, state override, gas, value, or calldata shape is invalid.
nextSteps: Compare the request against Tenderly's simulateTransaction parameter schema.
title: tenderly_simulateTransaction invalid params
summary: Tenderly rejected the simulation request parameters.

likelyCauses: The simulation request was malformed, unsupported, or could not reconstruct the transaction context.
For UserOperations, the bundled operation may not decode or replay cleanly.
nextSteps: Validate the simulation payload, chain, sender, target, calldata, and block context.
If this came from a wallet/API dashboard, inspect the underlying user operation or transaction request.
title: Tenderly simulation failed
summary: A Tenderly-backed simulation failed before producing a useful execution trace.

likelyCauses: Too many simulations were requested in the current limit window.
nextSteps: Reuse cached simulation links when possible, add backoff, or reduce automatic simulation frequency.
title: Tenderly simulation rate limit reached
summary: The transaction simulation was blocked by a Tenderly simulation quota or rate limit.

likelyCauses: The chain is not supported by the Tenderly integration, or the failure type does not match debug/simulate requirements.
nextSteps: Check the chain support table and fall back to native RPC trace/debug methods when available.
title: Tenderly unsupported network
summary: The transaction cannot be debugged or simulated through Tenderly for this network/context.
